notes: Three co-transmitters into one route. «وألفاظهم متقاربة» is a wording remark. In Muhammad b. Abbad's story, Muslim b. Yasar asks Ibn Umar while Muhammad sits between them: he is in the scene and the answer is Ibn Umar's, so Muslim is not written (rule 5 and 6). The text runs words together («متقاربةقالوا»).
